title: Language of Chemistry: Valency & 15 Balanced Equations
subject: Chemistry

sections.heading: Valency of Radicals & Elements:
sections.content:
• Sodium (Na⁺): Valency = +1 (Monovalent)
• Calcium (Ca²⁺): Valency = +2 (Divalent)
• Aluminium (Al³⁺): Valency = +3 (Trivalent)
• Carbonate (CO₃²⁻): Valency = -2
• Sulphate (SO₄²⁻): Valency = -2
• Nitrate (NO₃⁻): Valency = -1

sections.heading: Balanced Chemical Equations:
sections.content:
1) 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO (Combustion of Magnesium ribbon)
2) Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl₂ + H₂↑ (Laboratory preparation of H₂)
3) 2H₂O₂ → 2H₂O + O₂↑ (Decomposition with MnO₂ catalyst)
4) CaCO₃ + 2HCl → CaCl₂ + H₂O + CO₂↑
